Reference produces the same tags and calls.

Reference tests pass with the candidate's API as read: test_nifti_saver calls save_batch with filename-only meta (nifti_saver.py:105); test_plot calls plot_2d_or_3d_image(torch.zeros(shape), 0, SummaryWriter()) (img2tensorboard.py:134,152); test_handler_tb_image uses identity batch_transform (tensorboard_handlers.py:206-208).

Note (edge, not a blocker): for a 3D item with shape[0]==0 and max_channels>=1, candidate img2tensorboard.py:161 d[0] raises IndexError. Base (tensorboard_handlers.py:235-ish loop over d[:max_channels]) and the reference's enumerate(d[:max_channels]) silently write nothing.

Note (unrequested change): the TensorBoard handler now calls batch_transform once (tensorboard_handlers.py:206). Base called it twice (base tensorboard_handlers.py:205 and :213). This is benign unless batch_transform has side effects; the reference keeps the double call.

Note (improvement): ClassificationSaver's completion-hook dedupe works via the bound method (classification_saver.py:50). The reference's has_event_handler(self.saver.finalize) check would never match its lambda registration.
criteria.deficiency: None blocking. Edge-case IndexError on zero-channel 3D input and single batch_transform call are minor deviations noted above.
